title: Mapping a List After Dropping Its First Entry
statement: For a Boolean list $q$ and a natural number $k<|q|$, mapping the bit-to-quantifier interpretation over the list obtained by dropping its first $k$ entries gives the quantifier corresponding to $q_k$, followed by the mapped list obtained by dropping the first $k+1$ entries.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number k with k < |q|
